Subsystem guidance lives in `.claude/rules/*.md`. Each file has a `paths:` list and Claude Code loads it when you read or edit a matching file. When you review a diff or plan work in a subsystem without opening its files, open the rule file yourself. The index is at the end of this file.

## Production is this working tree

- `alltogether.service` runs `venv/bin/uvicorn allTogether3:app --port 8001` with `WorkingDirectory=/root/defGen2` and `EnvironmentFile=/root/defGen2/.env`. A restart serves whatever is in this tree, committed or not.
- Flags and model ids are read at import, so changing `.env` or code needs `systemctl restart alltogether.service`. Never start a second server on port 8001.
- Scheduled generation is `defgen2-generation.timer` with `scripts/isw_gate.py` as `ExecCondition=`. Unit files are tracked in `systemd/` and installed in `/etc/systemd/system/`; change both.
- Logs: `logs/defenseapi.log`, `journalctl -u alltogether.service`, `journalctl -u defgen2-generation.service`.
- Live flags in `.env` (read 2026-11-03): `STORY_EXTRACTION_ENABLED=1`, `CONTINUITY_ENABLED=true`, `BLUESKY_ENABLED=true`, `SUBSTACK_ENABLED=true`, `REFRESH_SHADOW_JUDGE=1`, `NARRATIVE_SHADOW_MODEL` empty (shadow writer off). Re-read `.env` before relying on these.

## Rules that apply everywhere

{{D 14-14}}
- `scripts/generate_today.sh` and `POST /generate_narrations/` start billable generation. Run them only when a generation is the task.
- Log secrets by presence only, never by value. An ntfy topic is bearer-equivalent (`.claude/rules/ntfy.md`).
- Owner decisions, do not reopen them: `MAX_TOPICS` (default 5) is the owner's choice (`.claude/rules/topics.md`). Unresolved source conflicts must not block publication, and content never changes to satisfy a check (`.claude/rules/narrative-integrity.md`).
- `tests/acceptance/` holds pinned contracts and is immutable by convention.
- `sg` on this machine is the shadow-utils group command, not ast-grep. Use `rg`.

{{L 303-340}}

## Commands

```bash
venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/<file>.py -q      # targeted; tests/ has ~110 files
venv/bin/python -m pytest -m llm_eval <file>      # live, billable LLM calls
venv/bin/python scripts/verify_guardrails.py      # are the guarded claims in .claude/rules still true
systemctl status alltogether.service
```

## Rule index (`.claude/rules/`)

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `articles.md` | Article inbox, contract 2.2.0 |
| `osint-telegram.md`, `osint-bluesky.md`, `substack.md` | Source fetchers and their env vars |
| `ntfy.md` | Report-ready push, NTFY_TOPIC handling |
| `isw.md` | ISW tiers, alerting, finalizer probe |
| `tts.md` | ElevenLabs timestamps, `text_map` |
| `shadow-writer.md` | GPT-6 Astra shadow drafts (off) |
| `continuity.md` | Longitudinal memory, continuity briefs |
| `source-registry.md` | Schema 1.5.1 sources, provenance, geocoding, attribution floors |
| `guardrail-checks.md` | `verify_guardrails.py`, repo-walking tests |
| `narrative-integrity.md` | Truncation, date clamps, source-conflict audit, owner policies |
| `edition-quality.md` | Edition warnings, gate audit, titles |
| `forum-topics.md` | Forum-process topic drop |
| `output-style.md` | Writer voice; canonical text is `ArticleGenerator.system_prompt` |
| `topics.md` | Topic dedup and story-first extraction |
| `generation-scripts.md` | `scripts/generate_*.sh`, multi-date, Reddit URLs, Ukraine tools |
| `api-requests.md` | Endpoints and the date contract |
| `refresh.md` | When a briefing is generated (three doors) |

Sections that described tools no longer present here (ChunkHound, the MCP memory server, the old `nohup` server procedure, root-level module paths) are in `docs/claude-md-archive-2026-11-03.md`.

Off since the shadow week: `NARRATIVE_SHADOW_MODEL` is empty in `.env` (checked 2026-11-03).
